thread.title: Apple (AAPL) was Downgraded to a Hold Rating at Jefferies

author: Carrie Williams
title: Apple (AAPL) was Downgraded to a Hold Rating at Jefferies
text:
Carrie Williams - January 3, 2019, 9:00 AM EDT SHARE ON:
Apple ( AAPL ) received a Hold rating and a $160 price target from Jefferies analyst Timothy O’Shea today. The company’s shares closed yesterday at $157.92, close to its 52-week low of $146.59.
According to TipRanks.com , O’Shea is ranked #1883 out of 5110 analysts.
Apple has an analyst consensus of Moderate Buy, with a price target consensus of $192.26, implying a 21.7% upside from current levels. In a report released today, New Street also upgraded the stock to Hold.
.

Based on Apple’s latest earnings release for the quarter ending September 30, the company reported a quarterly revenue of $62.68 billion and net profit of $14.13 billion. In comparison, last year the company earned revenue of $88.48 billion and had a net profit of $20.07 billion.
